title: Corpus entry (typed frontmatter + atomic blocks)
description: arch §3.3: typed entries (§3.3.4, Tana supertag pattern — schema-on-write); block-level atomicity (§3.3.2 — lineage/confidence/citations attach to atoms); links computed, never stored (§3.3.1 — this schema deliberately has NO backlink field; backlink/graph indexes are derived and rebuildable). The markdown file is the system of record; this schema describes its frontmatter + block structure as parsed.

entry_id.description: Stable id of the entry (also the lineage-sidecar entity id)

entry_type.description: §3.3.4 typed entries: decision/definition/owner/norm make the corpus queryable; context/profile/experience are the scope object types (§3.1)

scope.description: Which cascade scope the entry lives at (§3.1)

status.description: Lifecycle state; tombstoned = L9 deletion marker

blocks.description: §3.3.2 block-level atomicity: the addressable atoms of the entry

block_id.description: Stable block id — lineage and citations attach here

lineage_sidecar.description: Path to the entry's PROV-lite lineage sidecar (lineage-sidecar.schema.json) — every entry carries memory-write metadata (§3.2.1)
